paper_ref: arXiv:2601.12331 Fig.5 / Sec. V-C (ASR vs embedding size); data protocol not stated (F11/A13)
question: Which data protocol reproduces the paper's Fig.5 ASR trend (CAPRISE 53.5->88.8%, ADCPE 65.8->94.6% over the 12 sizes 64..2048)?

protocols.H2_trunc_raw: first min(d,768) coords, no renormalisation, zero-pad above 768
protocols.H3_trunc_renorm: first min(d,768) coords, L2 normalise, zero-pad above 768

setup.attack: DB vector as test query; encrypt DB with CAPRISE (3sβ/8) and ADCPE (sβ/4); rank ciphertext distances; ASR@t = top-t overlap

summary.note: The paper's protocol is unknown (F11). A protocol reproduces the trend only if its range is comparable to the paper's (~53->89 pp) and the Spearman correlation across the 12 sizes is high; the synthetic-uniform protocol (exp4) is flat by construction.
